title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]
source: MR > R1 > RX (purported to be 2nd gen)

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality, age‑marked recording captures a nostalgic show that shines on Good Lovin' and an electrifying Lovelight finale
ai_review.review: The tape shows its age – it’s garbled and dusty in places – but the performance delivers especially toward the end. Jerry’s high‑voltage guitar on the closing Lovelight and Pigpen’s soulful vocal on Good Lovin' are highlighted as magical moments, rewarding listeners who stick around despite the early roughness.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it praises the show’s climax but notes significant recording flaws, leading to a moderate‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Age‑related tape hiss and garbled sections; occasional clarity on later songs (Good Lovin', Lovelight) but overall dusty, muffled sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert builds slowly with some uneven early moments, then rewards patient listeners with a high‑energy finish and standout vocal/guitar highlights.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑voltage, unique guitar work on the Lovelight finale.
